metadata_description: Understand and control necessary, preference, analytics and marketing storage.
title: Cookie and local-storage preferences
description: Choose optional categories without blocking necessary application functions.
necessary_description: Used for essential functions such as your local workspace, security choices and saved preferences.
optional_description: Preference, analytics and marketing categories remain off until you choose them.
control_description: You can reopen these settings from the footer and update your choice.
banner_description: Practicora uses necessary local storage for core functions. Optional categories require your choice.
analytics_short: Measure aggregate product usage after consent.
marketing_short: Support campaign attribution only after consent.
